_about: Generated by studies/model/build-finance.py; verified against LibreOffice recalculation by verify-finance.py.

scenarios.A: University-oriented student apartments with a public-benefit focus (UVM-owned and financed, academic-year leases, rent anchored to UVM's own published rates).
scenarios.B: Explicitly hypothetical premium privately developed student apartments (ensuite bathrooms, upgraded finishes and amenities, 12-month leases). Not proposed for the real UVM project.

inputs.label: Beds
inputs.source: Trinity Rise baseline 300-400 beds (low end), Trinity Redistricting v1.3 facts 'rise_beds'. Not re-tested at 8-12 stories.

inputs.label: Beds per apartment
inputs.source: Plans rise-r4a (A) and rise-r4b (B); all-four-bedroom mix. Studios and two-bedrooms not yet modelled.

inputs.label: Apartment area per bed
inputs.source: 1,456 sf apartment envelope / 4 beds (both options share the envelope)

inputs.label: Building efficiency (apartment area / gross area)
inputs.source: Test fit: 8 units per floor x 12 stories = 502 gsf per bed; 364 / 502 = 0.725

inputs.label: Base development cost per bed, before contingency and financing
inputs.source: Benchmark only: Virginia Tech, $280M for 1,200 beds (about $233,000/bed, hard + soft), authorized June 2026 (Trinity facts 'bench_vt'). Different place, program, and date; not a Trinity estimate.

inputs.label: Premium increment per bed (ensuite baths, finishes, amenities)
inputs.source: No cost data. Placeholder; see the premium sensitivity table.

inputs.label: Additional contingency on base cost
inputs.source: Whether the benchmark already carries contingency is unknown.

inputs.label: Hard-cost share (display only)
inputs.source: Used only to split cost into hard and soft for display.

inputs.label: Construction period
inputs.source: No schedule study.

inputs.label: Average share of construction debt outstanding
inputs.source: Simple S-curve approximation.

inputs.label: Construction-period interest rate
inputs.source: No rate quote. A: institutional borrowing; B: private construction loan.

inputs.label: Debt share of cost
inputs.source: A: fully debt-financed by the university (illustrative). B: 60% loan-to-cost, 40% equity.

inputs.label: Permanent interest rate
inputs.source: No rate quote.

inputs.label: Rent per bed per lease (anchor)
inputs.source: A: UVM AY 2026-27 Premium tier, University Heights Suite Single, $12,090 (room only, academic year), https://www.uvm.edu/housingdining/costs, observed 2026-11-06. Used as an anchor, not a Rise rate. B: BLANK. Enter surveyed comparable rents (Redstone Lofts, University Commons, Spinner Place, off-campus 4BR) with dates before relying on B.

inputs.label: Lease length
inputs.source: A: academic year, matching UVM rate basis. B: 12-month private lease.

inputs.label: Stabilized occupancy
inputs.source: No demand study (Trinity Phase 0 requires one).

inputs.label: Other income (% of rent)
inputs.source: B: parking, fees, retail; A: none assumed.

inputs.label: Operating expenses per bed per year (excl. property tax)
inputs.source: No operating data. B adds amenity staffing.

inputs.label: Property tax or PILOT per bed per year
inputs.source: Tax treatment of a university-owned or ground-leased building is not analysed.

inputs.label: Exit capitalization rate
inputs.source: No market cap-rate evidence gathered.

notes: Trinity Rise allowance upper bound per bed (~$467k, rise_per_bed)

timeline.phase: Phase 0 feasibility (demand, site, zoning, delivery model)
